exercises.question: Which sentence gives background description in the past? [¿Cuál da una descripción de fondo en el pasado?]
options: La cocina olía a pan recién hecho. [The kitchen smelled of freshly baked bread.]
Un domingo cambiamos la receta. [One Sunday we changed the recipe.]
Mi madre compró los ingredientes en la tienda. [My mother bought the ingredients at the shop.]

exercises.sentence: Cuando era niño, mi abuela __ una receta tradicional cada domingo.
exercises.english: When I was a child, my grandmother used to prepare a traditional recipe every Sunday.
The kitchen smelled of freshly baked bread and the whole family waited for the meal.

sentences: Cuando era niño, mi abuela preparaba la comida. [When I was a child, my grandmother used to prepare the food.]
Además, la cocina olía a pan recién hecho. [Also, the kitchen smelled of freshly baked bread.]
Un domingo cambiamos la receta. [One Sunday we changed the recipe.]

exercises.question: Which form is needed for a repeated past action? [¿Qué forma se necesita para una acción habitual en el pasado?]
options: preparaba [used to prepare]
preparó [prepared once]
preparará [will prepare]

exercises.sentence: Mi abuela había __ la receta de su madre.
exercises.english: My grandmother had inherited the recipe from her mother.
One Sunday we changed the recipe because we did not have all the ingredients.

exercises.sentence: Cuando era niño, mi abuela preparaba una receta tradicional cada domingo.
options: When I was a child, my grandmother used to prepare a traditional recipe every Sunday.
When I was a child, my grandmother prepared the recipe once.
My grandmother will prepare a recipe every Sunday.

exercises.sentence: La cocina olía a pan recién hecho y toda la familia esperaba la comida.
options: The kitchen smelled of freshly baked bread and the whole family waited for the meal.
The kitchen smelled of burnt food and everyone left.
The family bought bread after the kitchen closed.

exercises.sentence: Mi abuela había heredado la receta de su madre, que la preparaba de la misma manera.
exercises.english: My grandmother had inherited the recipe from her mother, who prepared it in the same way.

exercises.sentence: Un domingo cambiamos la receta porque no teníamos todos los ingredientes.
options: One Sunday we changed the recipe because we did not have all the ingredients.
Every Sunday we changed the recipe because we had too many ingredients.
One Sunday we will change the recipe after buying everything.
Mi abuela preparaba una receta tradicional que había heredado de su madre. [My grandmother used to prepare a traditional recipe that she had inherited from her mother.]
Mi abuela prepararía una receta tradicional que heredaba de su madre. [My grandmother would prepare a traditional recipe that she used to inherit from her mother.]
Mi abuela preparó cada domingo mientras era niño. [My grandmother prepared once every Sunday while I was a child.]
Cambiamos la receta porque no teníamos todos los ingredientes. [We changed the recipe because we did not have all the ingredients.]
Cambiábamos la receta porque no tengamos todos los ingredientes. [We were changing the recipe because we do not have (subjunctive) all the ingredients.]
Cambiaremos la receta porque no teníamos todos los ingredientes. [We will change the recipe because we did not have all the ingredients.]
Porque era tradicional y mi abuela la había heredado de su madre. [Because it was traditional and my grandmother had inherited it from her mother.]
Porque será tradicional y mi abuela la heredará de su madre. [Because it will be traditional and my grandmother will inherit it from her mother.]
Porque sea tradicional y mi abuela la haya heredado de su madre. [Because it is (subjunctive) traditional and my grandmother has inherited it from her mother.]

template.prompt: Describe a food tradition from your childhood or family.
template.answer: Cuando era pequeño, mi familia preparaba una receta tradicional cada domingo, aunque a veces cambiábamos algún ingrediente.

template.prompt: Describe a past food tradition and one change that happened.
template.answer: Antes comíamos juntos los domingos, pero un año cambiamos la rutina porque todos empezamos a trabajar más.
